card.name: Words just before 'specific' or 'induration'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'in' or 'of' right after 'increase' or a mm size, mostly in tuberculin skin test text. Also adverbs like 'exclusively' or 'surprisingly' before a descriptive word.

modes.label: Skin test size change
modes.description: Linking word or symbol after 'increase' or a mm value, before 'reaction size' or 'induration'.

modes.label: Adverb before a qualifier
modes.description: An adverb that sits before an adjective or noun in general prose.
modes.example: The antibodies are<< exclusively>> of the IgG subtype
